paragraphs: Since 2006, Benson families have trusted us to care for their smiles. With a focus on compassion and comfort, we provide dental care that supports your family’s dental health journey year after year.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Our Benson office sits conveniently off Highway 210 near I-40, making it easy for patients traveling from Dunn, Four Oaks, or McGee’s Crossroads to access care. Nestled in a growing community south of Raleigh, this location offers small-town charm with modern convenience.

At Riccobene Family Dentistry in Benson, we believe every patient deserves gentle, personalized treatment. With nearby neighborhoods like Hannah’s Creek and easy access for Johnston County residents, our Benson office ensures top-notch dental care close to home.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Benson office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
Yes - we’re accepting new patients. Book an appointment online or give us a call and we’ll get you scheduled for an appointment.

Yes - we offer emergency dental care. We make every effort to see emergency patients same day if our office is open and staffed or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Benson location, we have offices throughout the region that may be able to accommodate short notice, after hours, or weekend visits for emergencies.
Yes, cosmetic dentistry services including professional teeth whitening are available.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

Give us a call, or book an appointment online and we’ll get you on the schedule for a visit as soon as possible! We look forward to helping you achieve your dental goals and keep your smile bright, white broad and beautiful.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Benson office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.
Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

Call our Benson Office at 919-207-2077, or use the form below to request an appointment.

Christina Boctor, DDS
MORE+
Christina Boctor, DDS
Dr. Christina Boctor grew up in Raleigh, NC, and earned her bachelor's degree in Biological Sciences from NC State University before attending the Adams School of Dentistry at UNC. Inspired by a two-year internship in a dental office, she found her calling in dentistry and is passionate about serving patients and building their confidence through healthy smiles. She stays active in study clubs, enjoys traveling, hiking, the outdoors, sporting events, and church activities. Dedicated to her community, she warmly welcomes patients of all ages.
VIEW PROFILE
Yoseph Saleh, DDS
MORE+
Yoseph Saleh, DDS
Dr. Yoseph Saleh grew up in Brooklyn, NY, and moved to North Carolina in 2009. He graduated from NC State in 2012 and earned his D.D.S. from NYU College of Dentistry in 2016, where he received the Dr. Robert Sussman Award for clinical excellence and humanitarian values. He completed his residency at Woodhull Medical Hospital and advanced training in implant surgery with the AAID. Now living in Apex, NC, Dr. Saleh is passionate about helping patients smile and enjoys family time, travel, fitness, and cooking.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Do you accept new patients at your Benson office?

Yes - we’re accepting new patients. Book an appointment online or give us a call and we’ll get you scheduled for an appointment.

Does your Benson location offer emergency dental care?

Yes - we offer emergency dental care. We make every effort to see emergency patients same day if our office is open and staffed or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Benson location, we have offices throughout the region that may be able to accommodate short notice, after hours, or weekend visits for emergencies.

Do you provide cosmetic dentistry in Benson, NC?

Yes, cosmetic dentistry services including professional teeth whitening are available.

Does your Benson location accept dental insurance?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

How can I schedule an appointment at Riccobene Family Dentistry, Benson office?

Give us a call, or book an appointment online and we’ll get you on the schedule for a visit as soon as possible! We look forward to helping you achieve your dental goals and keep your smile bright, white broad and beautiful.
